% 06.05.2025 CM APPL 27391/2025 (By appellant for deletion of name of deceased appellant Smt.
Rama Devi wife of late Shri Sardar Singh and for impleading the LRs of deceased petitioner Sardar Singh)

1. By way of present application, the applicant/appellant seeks deletion of name of deceased appellant Smt. Rama Devi wife of late Shri Sardar Singh and for impleading the LRs of deceased petitioner Sardar Singh.
2. Learned counsel for the appellants states that Sardar Singh was the petitioner before the Reference Court and during pendency of which Sardar Singh has expired and his LRs were impleaded and that all the legal heirs were brought on record before the Reference Court.
It is now stated that Smt. Rama Devi, wife of late Sardar Singh, has also expired.
3. Issue notice.
4. Notice is accepted by learned counsel for the non- applicants/respondent.
This is a digitally signed order.

For the reasons mentioned in the application, the name of Smt. Rama Devi wife of late Shri Sardar Singh is deleted.
As the LRs of deceased Sardar Singh are already on record as Appellant Nos. 2 to 6, therefore there is no cause for impleading the LRs again.

6. The application stands disposed of accordingly.
1. By way of present appeal filed under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 the appellants seek to assail the award/judgment dated 18.01.2025 passed by the Addl. District Judge (North),
Rohini, Delhi in LAC No. 465/2019 seeking enhancement of compensation awarded in respect of award No.19/2005-06 pertaining to Village Bawana, Delhi.
2. It is informed that the other similarly situated persons have also preferred appeals pertaining to above Award and the village.

Reference is made to Land Acquisition Appeal No. 19/2014 titled as "M/s Shivalik Dairies (P) Ltd. v/s Union of India" which already stands admitted and listed in the category of 'Regular Matters'.
3. Issue notice.

sentences.text: 4. Notice is accepted by learned counsel for the respondents.

5. Admit.
6.

In view of the above, list this matter along with L.A. APP No. 19/2014 in the category of 'Regular Matters'.
7.
In the meantime, the Registry shall make an endeavour to requisition digitised and bookmarked Reference Court record and place the same on record.
MANOJ KUMAR OHRI, J MAY 6, 2025/rd
